name: Ice Dream Land
address: A15 Airport Road, Plettenberg Bay, 6600, South Africa
description_short: Italian gelato and desserts in a family-friendly setting on Airport Road in Plett.
description_long:
Ice Dream Land brings authentic Italian gelato and desserts to Plettenberg Bay, serving up creamy scoops and sweet treats in a cheerful, family-oriented space on Airport Road. The gelato selection changes regularly, featuring classic flavours alongside local-inspired creations, all made with quality ingredients. Beyond the frozen treats, you'll find a selection of confectionery and Italian-style desserts that make it a popular stop for families and anyone with a sweet tooth.

The relaxed atmosphere makes it easy to linger over a cone or cup, and the convenient location near the airport means it's often a first or last stop for visitors to the area. Whether you're cooling down after a beach day or picking up treats for the road, Ice Dream Land delivers simple pleasures done well.
